column1: # Privacy boundary: the one list of patterns for secrets, phone numbers and CPF. Source of truth for workflow-memory (mem/validate.py)
# and for the wiki (server/priv/privacy-patterns.tsv is a copy; the wiki gate compares them on the laptop). Columns separated by a TAB:
# kind (secret|phone|cpf), flags (i = ignore case, or -), what it is (shown by the wiki), regex (Python re and PCRE both read it).
# E-mail addresses are not here: each program has its own policy for them.
